description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks." The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," displaying nine benchmarks with diagonally rotated labels: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the "Score (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 10. For each dataset category, two bars are grouped side-by-side. According to the legend titled "Model," the blue bars represent the "LLaMA-3-8B-it" model, while the orange bars represent a second model whose name is obscured by a gray rectangular block. Across the categories, the tallest bars are observed in the GSM-8K benchmark, where the blue bar reaches approximately 79% and the orange bar reaches about 80%. The shortest bars are found in the Chat-Arena-Hard category, with the blue bar at roughly 20% and the orange bar near 29%. Other approximate values include MMLU (blue 66%, orange 65%), HumanEval (blue 61%, orange 64%), TruthfulQA (blue 44%, orange 60%), ARC (blue 59%, orange 64%), MBPP (blue 61%, orange 61%), LC AlpacaEval-2 (blue 23%, orange 31%), and MT-Bench (x5) (blue 41%, orange 42%). The categories are not sorted in a strict alphabetical or descending order, and no individual bars are visually emphasized.
